name: Canada after the British defeat (WiF draft)

focuses.desc:
London has made peace with Berlin and Britain is a German protectorate. What is left of the Empire outside Europe and Africa now answers to Ottawa: India, Ceylon, the Caribbean, the Pacific islands and the Gulf - and Burma, Malaya and Singapore if Japan has not taken them. Canada never asked for an empire. It has one now, and it has to hold it.

This tree replaces Canada's focus tree when the Anglo-German peace hands Canada the Empire. It runs for about 8 years.

THE PACIFIC: only The War in the East branch depends on how the war with Japan ends. Every other focus works on land Canada holds in every outcome (India outside Bengal, Bihar and Assam; Ceylon; the Indian Ocean; the Gulf; the Caribbean). If Japan wins, its settlement gives Malaya, Singapore and British Borneo to its South East Asia protectorate (GEA) and Burma, Bengal, Bihar and Assam to the Indian Free State (IFS).

STARTING SPIRITS:
- The Crown in Exile (positive): the King leaves Britain for Ottawa. Britain loses its monarch spirit and Canada gets it.
- An Empire Adrift (negative, 3 tiers): -15% / -10% / -5% stability and -20% / -15% / -10% political power. Imperial Secretariat, Imperial Conference and An Empire of Willing Members each lower it one tier.
- Quebec Will Not Fight for London (negative): -1% recruitable population, -10% war support. Removed by The Conscription Question.

MECHANICS:
- IMPERIAL UNREST (0-100, starts 50): rises by 1 a month, and by 2 while Canada is at war. At 60 or more, a colony may rise in revolt each month: a state Canada owns outside the Americas breaks away as a rebel country at war with Canada. Lowered by focuses and by the Suppress Unrest decisions.
- INDIAN UNREST (0-100, starts 60): India's own value. At 80 or more the Quit India rising can fire and India (the Raj) breaks free of Canada. Lowered by the India focuses. While a Japanese Indian Free State exists on the border it rises 1 a month faster.
- ANZAC COHESION (0-100, starts 60): how tightly Australia and New Zealand hold to Canada. It falls by 1 a month, and by 5 for every Pacific state Japan takes from the alliance (-20 at once if Japan's settlement takes Papua and the Solomons). Below 30, Australia and New Zealand may leave the Free Commonwealth.

Effect: +50 political power. Unlocks the Imperial Unrest decisions.
focuses.name: The Empire Moves West

focuses.desc:
The King takes up residence at Rideau Hall. For the first time the sovereign lives in a dominion, and the whole Empire is watching.

Effect: +5% stability. -5 Imperial Unrest. +5 ANZAC Cohesion.
focuses.name: The Crown in Ottawa

focuses.desc:
Ministers, civil servants, officers and scientists who refused to serve the Protectorate cross the Atlantic.

Effect: Winston Churchill becomes available as a political advisor. +10% research speed for 2 years. +50 political power.
focuses.name: Welcome the Exiles

focuses.desc:
Canada's cautious, spiritualist Prime Minister now speaks for an empire of four hundred million.

Effect: +10% political power gain. +5% stability.
focuses.name: Mackenzie King Takes the Helm

focuses.desc:
Ottawa becomes the seat of the Empire, not just of Canada. An Imperial Cabinet with ministers from every dominion.

Effect: +15 ANZAC Cohesion. -10 Imperial Unrest. +15% political power gain.
But: Quebec is furious - the Conscription Question takes 50% longer and -5% stability for 2 years.
focuses.name: Imperial Federation

focuses.desc:
Canada will hold the Empire because it must, not because it wants to. Ottawa's interests come first.

Effect: +10% stability. The Conscription Question is free of its downside. Releasing colonies costs no Imperial Unrest.
But: -10 ANZAC Cohesion.
focuses.name: Canada First

focuses.desc:
Quebec voted against conscription once and will again. A plebiscite, a promise and a compromise: not necessarily conscription, but conscription if necessary.

Effect: removes Quebec Will Not Fight for London. +2% recruitable population. +5% war support.
focuses.name: The Conscription Question

focuses.desc:
A bilingual Quebec lawyer as Mackenzie King's heir binds French Canada to the Empire's cause.

Effect: +10% stability. +0.05 daily political power. Louis St. Laurent becomes the country leader when Mackenzie King retires (1948).
focuses.name: Louis St. Laurent

focuses.desc:
The King sails to Canberra, Wellington, Delhi and Kingston. A monarch who is seen is a monarch who is kept.

Effect: +10 ANZAC Cohesion. -5 Imperial Unrest. -5 Indian Unrest.
focuses.name: The Royal Tours

focuses.desc:
Eight years ago Canada inherited a broken empire. The Crown now sits as firmly in Ottawa as it ever did in London.

Effect: The Crown in Exile becomes The Crown of the Commonwealth (+15% stability, +10% political power gain).
focuses.name: The Realm Endures

focuses.desc:
The Colonial Office reopens in a requisitioned hotel on Wellington Street. Every governor in the Empire gets a new address to report to.

Effect: An Empire Adrift loses a tier. -5 Imperial Unrest.
focuses.name: The Imperial Secretariat

focuses.desc:
One police service for every colony, trained in Regina and led by men who know the ground.

Effect: Suppress Unrest decisions cost 25% less. -5 Imperial Unrest.
focuses.name: The Imperial Constabulary

focuses.desc:
Governors who took their orders from London are replaced by men loyal to Ottawa.

Effect: Imperial Unrest rises 0.5 a month slower. +25 political power.
focuses.name: New Governors for Old Colonies

focuses.desc:
The Mounties go abroad. Their intelligence branch watches the agitators, the smugglers and the German consuls.

Effect: a colony about to revolt now sends a warning event a month in advance. +1 operative slot. -5 Imperial Unrest.
focuses.name: The RCMP Imperial Branch

focuses.desc:
Jamaica, Trinidad, Barbados and the Leewards govern themselves together, under the Crown.

Effect: Caribbean states can no longer revolt. -10 Imperial Unrest.
focuses.name: The West Indies Federation

focuses.desc:
Self-government, local councils, a timetable for independence. Hold the colonies by letting them go slowly.

Effect: -20 Imperial Unrest. Imperial Unrest rises 0.5 a month slower. -10% political power gain for 2 years.
focuses.name: The Velvet Glove

focuses.desc:
Garrisons, curfews and emergency powers. Whoever rises will be put down.

Effect: Suppress Unrest decisions are twice as strong. +10% war support. A colony that revolts anyway adds +10 Imperial Unrest everywhere else.
focuses.name: The Iron Fist

focuses.desc:
Whatever happens in the Pacific, the Indian Ocean must stay the Empire's: Trincomalee, Mauritius, the Seychelles and the Cape route.

Effect: +1 naval base in Ceylon, Mauritius and the Seychelles. -5 Imperial Unrest.
focuses.name: An Imperial Lake

focuses.desc:
Ceylon's leaders have asked for self-government for twenty years. Give it to them and keep Trincomalee.

Effect: Ceylon can no longer revolt. +1 infrastructure in Ceylon. -5 Imperial Unrest.
focuses.name: A Constitution for Ceylon

focuses.desc:
The coaling stations and oil sheikhdoms of the Gulf - a long way from Ottawa and close to the Axis.

Effect: +1 refinery in Aden. +1 naval base in Aden. -5 Imperial Unrest.
focuses.name: Aden and the Gulf

focuses.desc:
The colonies stay not because Ottawa holds them but because they choose to.

Effect: removes An Empire Adrift. -15 Imperial Unrest. Imperial Unrest no longer rises on its own.
focuses.name: An Empire of Willing Members

focuses.desc:
Three hundred and fifty million people, a Viceroy whose King lives in Canada, and a Congress Party that has waited long enough.

Effect: shows Indian Unrest. -5 Indian Unrest.
focuses.name: The Indian Question

focuses.desc:
Linlithgow stays at his post and the Indian Civil Service stays loyal - for now.

Effect: India (the Raj) gets +10% stability. -5 Indian Unrest.
focuses.name: The Viceroy Answers to Ottawa

focuses.desc:
Release Nehru. Meet Gandhi. Find out what India's price is.

Effect: -10 Indian Unrest. -50 political power.
focuses.name: Talk to Congress

focuses.desc:
The Congress leaders go back to prison and the Viceroy governs by decree.

Effect: -15 Indian Unrest now, but Indian Unrest rises by 1 a month for the rest of the tree. +10% factory output in India.
focuses.name: Rule by Ordinance

focuses.desc:
A written promise: when the fighting is over, India becomes a self-governing dominion of the Crown.

Effect: -20 Indian Unrest. Unlocks The Dominion of India. -5% stability.
focuses.name: Dominion Status after the War

focuses.desc:
Two and a half million volunteers - the largest volunteer army in history, if India believes in the cause.

Effect: India gets +3% recruitable population and 6 infantry divisions. If Rule by Ordinance was taken: +10 Indian Unrest.
focuses.name: Raise the Indian Army

focuses.desc:
The rice from Burma has stopped - whether Burma fell or is only cut off - and India is hungry. Ship Canadian wheat, whatever it costs. If Japan's Indian Free State holds Bengal, the grain feeds the refugees who fled west.

Effect: -15 Indian Unrest. -50 political power. -20 convoys.
focuses.name: Grain for India

focuses.desc:
Five hundred princely states and a Muslim League that will not live under a Congress government. Every answer angers someone.

Effect: -5 Indian Unrest. Unlocks the Indian Settlement.
focuses.name: The Princes and the League

focuses.desc:
India stays a colony of the Crown. The garrison is doubled and the promises are forgotten.

Effect: India stays a Canadian colony. +20% resources from India. +20 Indian Unrest.
focuses.name: Keep the Jewel

focuses.desc:
India - whatever part of it Canada still holds - becomes a self-governing dominion with its own army and its own seat at the Imperial Conference.

Available: needs Dominion Status after the War.
Effect: India becomes a dominion and joins the Free Commonwealth as a member. Indian Unrest disappears. +10 ANZAC Cohesion.
focuses.name: The Dominion of India

focuses.desc:
However it was decided, the Indian question is answered.

Effect: -10 Imperial Unrest. +10% stability.
focuses.name: The Indian Settlement

focuses.desc:
Australia and New Zealand followed Britain into the war and Canada out of it. Whether they follow Canada any further is their choice.

Effect: shows ANZAC Cohesion. +5 ANZAC Cohesion.
focuses.name: The Pacific Dominions

focuses.desc:
Curtin, Fraser and Mackenzie King around one table, without London for the first time.

Effect: An Empire Adrift loses a tier. +10 ANZAC Cohesion.
focuses.name: Imperial Conference in Ottawa

focuses.desc:
Australia's whole defence was built on a British fleet that never came. Canada promises it will - and sits down with Canberra and Wellington to plan where.

Effect: +10 ANZAC Cohesion. Australia and New Zealand get +10% defence on their own core states.
focuses.name: The Pacific Defence Council

focuses.desc:
One staff for every Commonwealth army - planning together, training together.

Effect: Australia and New Zealand get +5% division attack and defence. +5 ANZAC Cohesion.
focuses.name: The Commonwealth Joint Staff

focuses.desc:
What remains of the Royal Navy sails for the Pacific.

Effect: an admiral and +10% naval doctrine speed. +10 ANZAC Cohesion. +1 naval base in Ceylon.
focuses.name: Send the Fleet East

focuses.desc:
Canada, Australia and New Zealand pledge to defend each other's Pacific territory.

Effect: +15 ANZAC Cohesion. ANZAC Cohesion falls 0.5 a month slower.
focuses.name: The Canberra Pact

focuses.desc:
Radar from Canada, aircraft from Australia, everything that came out of Britain - shared.

Effect: Canada, Australia and New Zealand join a shared research group. +5 ANZAC Cohesion.
focuses.name: Pool the Research

focuses.desc:
Wool, wheat, timber and Malayan rubber go round the Empire, not to Germany's markets.

Effect: +1 civilian factory for Australia and New Zealand. +5 ANZAC Cohesion.
focuses.name: The Pacific Trade Council

focuses.desc:
One crown, one foreign policy, one war. Australia and New Zealand are bound to Ottawa.

Effect: ANZAC Cohesion no longer falls on its own. Australia and New Zealand get -5% stability. Needs Imperial Federation.
focuses.name: A Union of Crowns

focuses.desc:
Free nations, freely allied. The dominions stay because it suits them.

Effect: +20 ANZAC Cohesion. Australia and New Zealand get +10% stability and +5% factory output.
focuses.name: A Partnership of Equals

focuses.desc:
Gallipoli, Tobruk - and now the Pacific. The alliance holds.

Effect: Australia and New Zealand can no longer leave the Free Commonwealth. +10% stability.
focuses.name: The ANZAC Alliance Endures

focuses.desc:
Canada has a small army, a rescued fleet and an empire to defend on four oceans.

Effect: +50 army, navy and air experience.
focuses.name: Arms of the Empire

focuses.desc:
The Royal Navy's new home port is on the Atlantic coast of Nova Scotia.

Effect: +2 naval base and +2 dockyards in Nova Scotia. +10% ship repair speed.
focuses.name: Halifax: Home of the Fleet

focuses.desc:
The Commonwealth Air Training Plan already turns out pilots by the thousand. Now it trains for an empire.

Effect: +100 air experience. Air wings train 25% faster.
focuses.name: The Air Training Plan

focuses.desc:
Same ensign, same traditions, a new Admiralty in Ottawa.

Effect: +10% naval doctrine research speed. +5% capital ship production. The British admirals who came with the fleet stay.
focuses.name: The Royal Navy Reborn

focuses.desc:
Squadrons on four continents under one command.

Effect: +10% air doctrine research speed. +5% air base construction speed.
focuses.name: Imperial Air Command

focuses.desc:
Canadians, Indians, Malays, West Indians and Africans in one army under the Crown.

Effect: +2% recruitable population. +10% division training speed.
focuses.name: The Imperial Army

focuses.desc:
Cheap, local, loyal - troops who keep order without stripping the field army.

Effect: a free Colonial Garrison template and 4 divisions. Suppress Unrest decisions also lower Imperial Unrest by 2.
focuses.name: Colonial Garrison Divisions

focuses.desc:
If Japan comes south, the Empire must already know where to meet it.

Effect: +10% attack and defence against Japan. +10 ANZAC Cohesion while at war with Japan.
focuses.name: War Plan Pacific

focuses.desc:
No part of the Empire is left undefended.

Effect: +10% division defence on owned non-core states. +100 army experience.
focuses.name: Shield of the Empire

focuses.desc:
C. D. Howe, the minister of everything, is told to supply an empire from Canadian factories.

Effect: +2 civilian factories. +5% factory output.
focuses.name: The Arsenal of the Empire

focuses.desc:
Machine tools, blueprints and engineers smuggled out before the Protectorate closed the ports.

Effect: +3 military factories in Ontario and Quebec. +10% production efficiency cap.
focuses.name: Relocate British Industry

focuses.desc:
Sterling is a German protectorate's currency now. The Empire trades in Canadian dollars.

Effect: +10% political power gain. -5 Imperial Unrest.
focuses.name: The Dollar Area

focuses.desc:
The Saguenay dams power the biggest aluminium smelter in the world.

Effect: +20 aluminium in Quebec. +1 civilian factory.
focuses.name: Hydro and Aluminium

focuses.desc:
Empire goods first, Empire markets first.

Effect: +10% resources in Canada's non-core states. -5% consumer goods.
focuses.name: Imperial Preference

focuses.desc:
Roosevelt and Mackenzie King pool North America's war production. Canada gets American factories - and American strings.

Effect: +4 civilian factories. +50 opinion with the USA. Imperial Unrest rises 0.5 a month faster (the colonies see Washington's hand).
focuses.name: The Hyde Park Declaration

focuses.desc:
The Empire will not trade a German master for an American one.

Effect: +2 military factories. +10% stability. -10 Imperial Unrest.
focuses.name: Imperial Self-Sufficiency

focuses.desc:
The Tube Alloys scientists who escaped Britain rebuild the atomic project in Montreal and at Chalk River.

Effect: +2 nuclear breakthrough progress. +10% nuclear research speed.
focuses.name: The Montreal Laboratory

focuses.desc:
Roads, schools and power stations in the colonies - the cheapest garrison there is.

Effect: +1 infrastructure in 6 colonial states. -10 Imperial Unrest. -10 Indian Unrest.
focuses.name: Colonial Development Fund

focuses.desc:
Canada's factories, the Empire's resources.

Effect: +3 civilian factories. +10% factory output.
focuses.name: The Empire Rebuilt

focuses.desc:
Germany made peace with the Empire. Japan did not have to. How the Pacific war ends decides what kind of empire Canada keeps in Asia.

Effect: +10% defence against Japan. Unlocks the three outcomes below - only the one that matches the war can be taken.
focuses.name: The War in the East

focuses.desc:
Japan has surrendered.

Available: Japan has capitulated to the Empire or its allies, or no longer exists.
Effect: +10% war support. +15 ANZAC Cohesion. -10 Imperial Unrest.
focuses.name: The Rising Sun Sets

focuses.desc:
Japan never came south, or the war has burnt out. The Empire holds what it held - and watches Tokyo.

Available: not at war with Japan, Japan has neither won nor surrendered, and the tree has run for at least a year.
Effect: +5% stability. +10% defence against Japan.
focuses.name: An Armed Peace in the Pacific

focuses.desc:
Singapore is a Japanese protectorate's capital. Rangoon and Calcutta fly the flag of the Indian Free State.

Available: Japan's Pacific settlement has been made.
Effect: +10% war support. -5 Imperial Unrest (the Empire closes ranks).
focuses.name: The Fall of the East

focuses.desc:
The Union Jack goes back up over Singapore, Kuala Lumpur and Kuching.

Effect: Canada takes Malaya, Singapore and British Borneo from Japan or its puppets if they still hold them, and gets their cores. -5 Imperial Unrest.
focuses.name: Return to Malaya

focuses.desc:
Burma comes back to the Empire - and Aung San's army wants to know on what terms.

Effect: Canada takes Burma if Japan or its puppets hold it. Burma can no longer revolt. -5 Indian Unrest.
focuses.name: Burma Restored

focuses.desc:
A Royal Navy squadron sails into Victoria Harbour to accept the surrender.

Effect: Canada takes Hong Kong if Japan or its puppets hold it. +1 naval base in Hong Kong.
focuses.name: The Return to Hong Kong

focuses.desc:
Canadian, Australian and Indian judges sit on the bench in Tokyo.

Effect: +10 ANZAC Cohesion. +10% war support.
focuses.name: The Tokyo Tribunal

focuses.desc:
The whole Empire came through the war - only a different capital is celebrating.

Effect: -15 Imperial Unrest. +15 ANZAC Cohesion. +10% stability for 2 years.
focuses.name: Victory in the Pacific

focuses.desc:
This time the guns will face north as well as south.

Effect: +2 land forts and +2 coastal forts in Singapore and Johor. +10 ANZAC Cohesion.
focuses.name: Fortress Singapore

focuses.desc:
A line from Burma through Malaya to Darwin, held together.

Effect: +1 land fort in every Burmese and Malayan border state. Australia and New Zealand get +10% defence against Japan.
focuses.name: The Malay Barrier

focuses.desc:
Peace with Japan is a ceasefire nobody signed.

Effect: +10% intel against Japan. +1 operative slot. -5 Imperial Unrest.
focuses.name: The Long Watch

focuses.desc:
Japan will not come south. The Empire will not go north. Both sides can live with that.

Effect: +10% stability. +10 ANZAC Cohesion.
focuses.name: Stalemate in the Pacific

focuses.desc:
Planters, clerks, Chinese merchants and Indian soldiers who would not live under Tokyo arrive in Ceylon and Madras.

Effect: +50,000 manpower. +5% research speed for 2 years. -5% stability for 1 year.
focuses.name: The Refugees from the East

focuses.desc:
The Indian Free State's border runs through Bengal. It must not run any further west.

Effect: +2 land forts in every Indian state bordering the Indian Free State. -10 Indian Unrest.
focuses.name: Hold the Brahmaputra

focuses.desc:
Papua and the Solomons are gone and Darwin is a frontier town. Canada sends what it can.

Effect: +15 ANZAC Cohesion. Australia gets +2 land forts and +1 naval base in Northern Territory and Queensland.
focuses.name: Fortress Australia

focuses.desc:
Every night Akamori's broadcasts tell India that Asia has thrown out the white man. Ottawa must answer.

Effect: the Indian Free State no longer raises Indian Unrest. -10 Indian Unrest.
focuses.name: Answer the Free Indian Radio

focuses.desc:
Malaya and Burma are lost. Better a smaller empire at peace than a bankrupt one at war.

Effect: -15 Imperial Unrest. +10% stability. +5% factory output. -10 ANZAC Cohesion.
focuses.name: Accept the Tokyo Settlement

focuses.desc:
The Empire will return to Singapore and Rangoon.

Effect: wargoals against the Indian Free State and South East Asia (GEA). +15% war support. +15 ANZAC Cohesion. +5 Imperial Unrest.
focuses.name: The Road Back

focuses.desc:
Whether by victory, stalemate or defeat, the Empire knows where its eastern border lies.

Effect: -10 Imperial Unrest. +5% stability.
focuses.name: The East Settled

focuses.desc:
The Empire lost its heart and kept its body. From Ottawa, under the Crown, it endures.

Effect: +15% stability. +10% political power gain. Imperial Unrest and the revolt mechanic end. The Free Commonwealth gets +5% stability for every member.
focuses.name: The Empire Endures
